meta.title: LLM Wiki
meta.description: Maintains a Karpathy-style interlinked markdown knowledge base: orientation, link linting, source ingestion with content hashing, and an append-only action log.

tool.orient: Read the wiki schema, index, and recent log before doing any work
tool.lint: Audit broken links, orphans, index gaps, source drift, and stale pages
tool.ingest: Store a source under raw/ with provenance frontmatter and a body hash
tool.log: Append one entry to the wiki's append-only log
